scope: Configuration-only Nx feature-project probe in a separate worktree; no trial wiring adopted by the mission branch

projectGraph.withoutTypescriptPlugin: Project metadata appeared but no source import edges were inferred; ^production could not safely hash transitive source inputs.

narrowButIncompleteInputs.reason: The target named input hashed the common bootstrap and runner files but omitted transitive agent, database, and test-lib source dependencies. The selective hit is unsafe.

conservativeRuntimeClosure.reason: The safe conservative closure pulls the whole remainder source project through common test-runtime dependencies, so this group has no selective reuse on the tested unrelated edit.

coverageProbe.result: 60 tests passed; LCOV included src/adapters/backlog/legacy-task-content.ts at zero hits although the application test target does not execute it.
coverageProbe.implication: A cached whole-repository LCOV fragment cannot safely use a narrow runtime-only source key. Component coverage fragments plus fresh source inventory, or conservative whole-source inputs, are required.

integrationCiProfile.constraint: The expensive files exercise CLI, package, process, or full-gate behavior; no complete narrow input model or feature-owned coverage artifacts were established for them.

scaleCheck.note: This is an illustrative ceiling for the 10.46-CPU-second application group alone, before Nx overhead and other gates; it is not a cohort result.

decision: Do not adopt this trial configuration. A feature-scoped model can produce a selective hit, but this probe showed that hit was unsafe; the conservative correction lost it. The broader Nx adoption question remains pending a safe runtime and coverage boundary plus a representative CPU replay.
